name: systemctl
summary: Control the systemd system and service manager.
description: Query or control the systemd system and service manager state and services.

options.description: Show terse runtime status of one or more units.
Enable unit(s) to start on boot.

examples.title: Check status of ssh service
examples.output:
● ssh.service - OpenBSD Secure Shell server
   Loaded: loaded (/lib/systemd/system/ssh.service; enabled)
   Active: active (running) since Mon 2026-10-12 10:00:00 UTC
examples.explanation: Displays systemd service status and recent logs.

warnings: systemctl changes the state of system services; enabling or stopping the wrong unit (especially as root) can affect boot or connectivity.
